zh.summary: 理解 AI 每次實際取得的資訊、上下文容量與有效使用的差別，透過預算互動與可交接的工作資料，保留正確規格和驗證證據。
objectives: 區分聊天介面保存的歷史與某次模型呼叫實際取得的上下文。
用明示假設的 token 預算，辨識超出容量及無關資訊擁擠的問題。
為長任務保留可重新讀取的規格、狀態與來源，避免只靠對話記憶。

readingGuide.goal: 為一次模型呼叫安排有限、相關且可回查的上下文。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先把聊天歷史與目前真正需要的規格、程式和測試結果分開。
readingGuide.route: 讀工作桌類比，計算合成預算，再替一次修正任務設計工作包。
readingGuide.output: 一份註明假設的預算與含來源、版本、未決問題的任務摘要。

sections.heading: 一、先用生活例子理解：AI 的工作桌
paragraphs: AI 回答時，未必重新閱讀你們過去講過的所有事情。它主要依靠這一次實際取得的資訊。Context Window（上下文視窗）限制一次能處理的上下文容量。
想像你聘請了一位聰明的工程師：他會寫程式、分析文件，也能設計網站，但每次工作只能根據桌面上擺出的資料做判斷。資料庫裡保存的文件，未必都放上這張桌子。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從保存資料到本次工作視窗
blocks.description: 虛線箭頭表示選取資料。左邊資料即使都存在，也不代表右邊的模型工作視窗已取得全部內容。

items.title: 資料庫／歷史紀錄
items.body: 保存 ≠ 全部讀取

items.title: Context Window
items.body:
任務與規則
相關文件
對話與工具結果
可用容量有限

blocks.heading: 四天之後，網站為什麼變成紫色？
paragraphs: 第一天，你告訴 AI：「我們的網站主要使用暖象牙白，搭配陶土紅。」第二天，你補充：「按鈕要統一圓角，標題要保持一致。」第三天，又討論了 100 個程式錯誤、20 次修改、50 份測試紀錄。
第四天，你說：「幫我繼續做網站。」AI 卻把網站設計成紫色。你可能會問：「我不是早就講過要用陶土紅了嗎？」僅憑這個結果，還不能判定錯誤原因。
可能是「沒看到」：最早的配色規則沒進入這次上下文；也可能是「看錯了」：新舊設計紀錄混在一起，模型採用了過時版本；還可能是「看到了卻沒照做」：規則其實在上下文裡，模型仍然犯錯。三種問題需要不同的檢查與解法。

sections.heading: 二、Context Window 裡面究竟裝了什麼？
paragraphs: Context Window 通常以 Token 為容量單位。M02-01 已說明：Token 是模型處理文字的基本單位，不等於一個中文字或一個英文單字。
你說「請幫我修改這段程式」時，模型可能不只收到這句話。一次 AI 工作可能還需要系統規則、工具說明、歷史片段、文件與輸出空間。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜一次 AI 工作可能需要的上下文
blocks.description: 實際組合、資訊選取方式及容量計算依模型與 AI 服務而不同；這五項是組成示意，不是所有產品固定的封裝格式。

items.title: 系統規則與工具說明
items.body: 任務邊界及可使用工具的資訊。

items.title: 你現在提出的要求
items.body: 這次要完成的工作。

items.title: 部分歷史對話與摘要
items.body: 被選入這次呼叫的歷史片段。

items.title: 程式碼、文件與查詢結果
items.body: 實際取得且與本次工作相關的資料。

items.title: 模型正在產生的回答
items.body: 依服務規則安排生成空間。

blocks.heading: 聊天歷史、記憶與目前上下文
paragraphs: Chat History（聊天歷史）與 Context Window（目前上下文）不同。在 ChatGPT 往上滑能看到幾個月前的對話，只證明介面仍能呈現那些紀錄，不能據此推定每次生成都收到完整歷史。
就像公司保存十年公文，並不表示承辦人每次辦案都同時閱讀十年的全部文件。要判斷這次看到什麼，應查看實際組裝的輸入與工具回傳。
模型的訓練知識、個人化 Memory（記憶）、外部文件檢索，也各有不同作用。訓練知識反映在模型參數中；Memory 或檢索結果則需經服務相應的選取與提供機制，才能作為這次可用的上下文。不能把它們視為同一種容量或保證全部被讀取。
實際限制可能還涉及輸出長度、圖片表示、工具訊息與額外封裝。確認特定服務上限時，要查指定模型、版本及 API 規則，不能將本課假設套用到所有產品。

sections.heading: 三、用互動實驗看看上下文為什麼會爆滿
paragraphs: 假設某個 AI 系統一次可使用 10,000 Token，且本練習把輸入與預留輸出放在同一個預算。所有數字都是教學指定值，不是真實 Tokenizer 或服務的量測。
系統規則 1,000、需求及程式 2,000、測試紀錄 4,500、預留回答 1,500，合計固定使用 9,000。額外日誌預設 500，所以合計 9,500，剩餘 500。調整日誌後，需求、程式與測試證據都不會增加，容量卻仍被占用。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜上下文預算互動
blocks.description: 假設上限 10,000 Token，輸入與預留回答共用預算。以下數值是日誌 500 的靜態預設；容量足夠不保證資訊被正確使用。這不是任何特定模型的實際限制。

blocks.heading: 把容量留給本次需要的資訊
paragraphs: 把滑桿往右拉，或試著加入 1,800 Token 日誌：合計成為 10,800，超出 800。日誌為 1,000 時恰好到上限；為 3,000 時合計 12,000，超出 2,000。圖中填滿預算條時，超出量仍以文字明確顯示。
工程師應優先讓 AI 取得完成本次任務所需的資料，保障重要規格與證據的空間。這稱為 Context Management（上下文管理）。無關日誌變多，並不會自動提高工作品質。

blocks.heading: 用 Python 離線核對
paragraphs: 使用 Python 3 標準函式庫，把程式存為 context_budget.py，執行 python3 context_budget.py。預期 reserved = 9500、remaining = 500、fits = True。把 extra_logs 改為 1800 後，預期 10800、-800、False。
blocks.code:
window = 10000
input_parts = {"rules": 1000, "requirements_and_code": 2000, "test_records": 4500}
output_reserve = 1500
extra_logs = 500
reserved = sum(input_parts.values()) + output_reserve + extra_logs
remaining = window - reserved
print("reserved =", reserved)
print("remaining =", remaining)
print("fits =", remaining >= 0)

sections.heading: 四、超大 Context Window 為什麼也不一定能解決問題？
paragraphs: 想像學生 A 的桌子只能放 10 本書，學生 B 的桌子能放 100 本。你問：「根據最新版規範，申請資料應該填寫哪些欄位？」學生 B 的資料若混有 30 份舊規範、20 份沒有日期的文件，即使桌子大，仍可能找錯。
容量、資料選取、版本衝突與使用失誤是不同問題。先確認是哪一種，再選擇改善方式。

blocks.heading: 資訊放得進去，還要檢查是否有效使用
paragraphs: Lost in the Middle 研究在多文件問答與鍵值檢索任務中，觀察到重要資訊所在位置可能影響模型表現，尤其位於長上下文中間時。不能把那組結果當成所有模型、所有任務都會出現相同程度問題的證明。
Context Window 處理「一次可能放多少」；資訊檢索處理「這次需要拿什麼」；版本管理處理「哪一份才有效」；驗證機制處理「究竟有沒有做對」。這四項工作各有責任，不能互相取代。

sections.heading: 五、建立可以交接的工作資料
paragraphs: 回到「文件收件與缺漏檢查系統」。假設你用 Coding Agent 開發它，已討論很久規格，現在要修正一個錯誤：使用者缺少必填文件，系統卻顯示「收件完成」。
「幫我繼續修改剛剛的收件工具。你應該知道規則是什麼。」沒有指出有效規格、錯誤證據與工作邊界。下面的交接範例把這些內容寫明。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜任務交接範例
blocks.description: 路徑、規格及測試案例均為教學假設，並非已建立或驗證的專案檔案。

items.title: 目標
items.body: 修正收件狀態判斷錯誤。

items.title: 有效規格
items.body: 以 docs/requirements-v3.md 為準，缺少必填文件不得顯示「收件完成」。

items.title: 已有證據
items.body: 測試 T-04 顯示缺少附件時，系統仍回報完成。

items.title: 未決問題
items.body: 選填文件是否影響狀態，尚未確認。

items.title: 工作範圍
items.body: 只修改狀態判斷邏輯與相關測試，不修改 UI 配色。

items.title: 停止條件
items.body: 遇到需求衝突或需要決定選填文件規則時先回報。

items.title: 完成條件
items.body: T-04 測試通過，提供實際測試結果。

blocks.heading: 讓下一位 Agent 可以接續工作
paragraphs: 這樣即使明天換另一個 AI Agent，也能知道現在要做什麼、遵守哪份規格、哪些東西不能動，以及如何判定完成。這稱為 Handoff（任務交接）。
軟體工程通常把這些資訊保存在 Git 專案的規格文件、測試檔與版本紀錄中。對話可以協助討論，正本則讓規則與證據可重新取得。

blocks.caption: 圖 5｜從規格正本到有證據的完成
blocks.description: 箭頭表示工作順序。執行後依測試與審查確認結果；正式決策須更新正本，供下次選取。

items.title: 規格正本（Source of Truth）
items.body: 現在有效的規則與版本。

items.title: 選取相關資料
items.body: 只拿本次需要的規格、程式與證據。

items.title: AI Agent 執行任務
items.body: 使用目前取得的 Context。

items.title: 測試、審查與更新紀錄
items.body: 有證據後才確認完成，必要時正式更新規格。

blocks.heading: 摘要與回答各能證明什麼？
paragraphs: 摘要不是正本，AI 的回答也不是驗證結果。例如摘要說「需求已全部完成」，但 Git 裡的測試仍失敗，就不能因為摘要這樣寫而當成完成。應回查實際命令、輸出與檔案版本。
修改規格時，將新決策正式寫回正本，避免下一次又取得舊規則。這是一個需要實際執行並驗證的工作流程，不表示任何 Agent 已自動完成全部步驟。

sections.heading: 六、怎麼判斷要不要開新對話？
paragraphs: 如果工作目標沒有改變、相關資料清楚，通常可以繼續現有對話。新對話與長對話都不是品質保證，應看這個工作階段的資料是否適用。
任務歷經多次需求變更、累積大量無關日誌，或 Agent 反覆引用錯誤的舊規格時，值得先整理交接資料，再開始乾淨的工作階段。
把過去有價值的資訊整理為現在可用的正確上下文：有效規格、必要證據、未決問題與驗收方式都要保留。下一課再比較摘要壓縮、RAG 與持久記錄，以及它們可能遺漏、過期或錯取資料的風險。

sections.heading: 七、理解檢核：AI 到底出了什麼問題？
paragraphs: 以下是合成教學情境：你們用 AI Agent 開發醫院內部收件系統，昨天已確認「只有管理員可以刪除收件紀錄」，今天 Agent 卻把刪除按鈕開放給所有登入使用者。請用後面的三題檢核判斷還需要哪些證據。
這堂課的核心是設計一個工作流程，讓 AI 每次都能取得正確規格與必要證據，並驗證工作成果。要求它永遠記住所有事情，不能代替這些具體安排。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或 Python 3；所有 token 數都使用本課題設，不需呼叫真實模型。
steps: 將必要規格、對話歷史與工具結果分成正本、當前必需、可回查三類，說明分類理由。
核對 9,500 的合成預算及剩餘 500；操作滑桿或執行 Python 範例。
把額外日誌設為 1,800 Token，核對超出 800，再決定哪些無關資料先移出工作包。
寫一份供下一次呼叫使用的任務摘要，含規格版本、來源、未決問題及仍需驗證的情境。
exercise.expected: 合成預算的計算與一份可回查來源的工作包；不宣稱這是真實服務的 token 計量。
exercise.check: 能說明「內容能放入」與「任務確實做對」的差別，並指出下一次呼叫需要重新取得哪些資訊。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成筆記；可刪除臨時預算程式，沒有建立外部模型或帳號。

openChecks.prompt: 問題 2：如果需求規格已經存在 Git 裡，為什麼 AI 仍然可能不知道這項權限規則？
answer: 檔案存在不代表這次已讀取。先確認讀到的路徑與版本、工具是否成功回傳相關內容，以及組裝的上下文是否包含「只有管理員可刪除」；也要檢查是否混入舊規則。

openChecks.prompt: 問題 3：你會如何修改交接方式，避免下一次再發生相同錯誤？
answer: 列出有效規格與版本、管理員／一般登入使用者的權限情境、目前失敗證據、允許修改的範圍、未決問題與停止條件。完成條件應包含相關權限測試的實際輸出；除了按鈕顯示，也要驗證伺服器端拒絕未授權刪除。將新決策與結果寫回正本，交接摘要保留證據位置。

en.summary: Distinguish the information available in each AI call, context capacity and effective use. Explore a token budget and prepare handoff records that retain the correct specification and verification evidence.
objectives: Distinguish chat history retained by the interface from context actually supplied to a model call.
Use an explicitly assumed token budget to identify capacity overflow and crowding by irrelevant material.
Retain rereadable specifications, state and sources for long tasks instead of relying only on conversation history.

readingGuide.goal: Prepare finite, relevant and traceable context for one model call.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Separate chat history from the specifications, code and test results currently needed.
readingGuide.route: Use the work-desk analogy, calculate a synthetic budget, then prepare a task packet for one correction.
readingGuide.output: An assumption-labeled budget and a task summary with sources, versions and unresolved questions.

sections.heading: 1. A Familiar Analogy: AI’s Work Desk
paragraphs: AI does not necessarily reread everything you have discussed before each response. It relies primarily on information actually available in this call. The context window limits how much context can be processed at once.

Imagine hiring a capable engineer who can code, analyze documents and design websites, but can judge each task only from the materials on the desk. Documents retained in a database are not necessarily on that desk.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Stored Records to the Current Work Window
blocks.description: The dashed arrow represents selection. Records on the left can exist without all their contents reaching the model’s work window on the right.

items.title: Database / history
items.body: Stored does not mean fully read

items.title: Context Window
items.body:
Task and rules
Relevant documents
Conversation and tool results
Available capacity is limited

blocks.heading: Why Does the Website Turn Purple on Day Four?
paragraphs: On day one, you tell AI, “Our website mainly uses warm ivory with terracotta red.” On day two, you add, “Buttons should have consistent rounded corners, and headings should stay consistent.” On day three, you discuss 100 code errors, 20 revisions and 50 test records.
On day four, you ask, “Help me continue building the website,” and AI makes it purple. You might ask, “Didn’t I already say terracotta red?” The result alone does not identify the cause.

It may not have seen the rule because the original color requirement was absent from this context. It may have used the wrong version because old and new design records were mixed. Or it may have seen the rule but failed to follow it. These three problems require different checks and remedies.

sections.heading: 2. What Goes into a Context Window?
paragraphs: Context-window capacity is usually measured in tokens. As M02-01 explained, a token is a basic unit of model text processing, not necessarily one Chinese character or one English word.
When you ask, “Please modify this code,” the model may receive more than that sentence. An AI task can also require system rules, tool descriptions, history excerpts, documents and room for output.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Context an AI Task May Need
blocks.description: The actual combination, selection process and capacity accounting depend on the model and service. These five categories illustrate composition, not a fixed message format for every product.

items.title: System rules and tool descriptions
items.body: Task boundaries and information about available tools.

items.title: Your current request
items.body: The work to accomplish now.

items.title: Some conversation history and summaries
items.body: Historical material selected for this call.

items.title: Code, documents and query results
items.body: Retrieved material relevant to this task.

items.title: The response being generated
items.body: Generation space accounted for under the service’s rules.

blocks.heading: Chat History, Memory and Current Context
paragraphs: Chat history and current context differ. Scrolling up in ChatGPT to see conversations from months ago establishes that the interface can display those records; it does not establish that every generation receives all of them.
A company can retain ten years of documents without an officer reading every one of them for each case. To determine what was available in this call, inspect the assembled input and tool results.

Training knowledge, personalized memory and external document retrieval also have different roles. Training knowledge is reflected in model parameters; memory or retrieved results require the service’s selection and delivery mechanisms to become available context. They are not the same capacity measure, nor a guarantee that everything is read.

Actual constraints may also involve output length, image representations, tool messages and additional overhead. Check the specified model, version and API rules for a real service rather than applying this lesson’s assumptions to every product.

sections.heading: 3. Explore Why Context Can Overflow
paragraphs: Assume an AI system can use 10,000 tokens at once, with input and reserved output sharing one budget in this exercise. All counts are assigned teaching values, not measurements from an actual tokenizer or service.

System rules use 1,000 tokens, requirements and code 2,000, test records 4,500 and reserved output 1,500: a fixed total of 9,000. Extra logs default to 500, giving 9,500 used and 500 remaining. Increasing logs does not add requirements, code or test evidence, but still consumes capacity.

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Interactive Context Budget
blocks.description: The assumed limit is 10,000 tokens shared by input and reserved output. These are static defaults with 500 log tokens. Fitting the budget does not guarantee correct use of information, and this is not a real model limit.

blocks.heading: Reserve Capacity for Information the Task Needs
paragraphs: Move the slider right or try 1,800 log tokens: the total becomes 10,800, exceeding the limit by 800. Logs of 1,000 exactly fill the budget; logs of 3,000 give 12,000, exceeding it by 2,000. When the budget bar fills, the overflow remains explicitly stated in text.

Engineers should prioritize the material needed for this task and protect space for important specifications and evidence. This is context management. More irrelevant logs do not automatically improve task quality.

blocks.heading: Check the Budget Offline with Python
paragraphs: Use Python 3 and its standard library. Save this as context_budget.py and run python3 context_budget.py. Expect reserved = 9500, remaining = 500 and fits = True. Set extra_logs to 1800 to obtain 10800, -800 and False.
blocks.code:
window = 10000
input_parts = {"rules": 1000, "requirements_and_code": 2000, "test_records": 4500}
output_reserve = 1500
extra_logs = 500
reserved = sum(input_parts.values()) + output_reserve + extra_logs
remaining = window - reserved
print("reserved =", reserved)
print("remaining =", remaining)
print("fits =", remaining >= 0)

sections.heading: 4. Why a Much Larger Context Window May Not Solve the Problem
paragraphs: Imagine student A has a desk for 10 books and student B has room for 100. You ask, “Which application fields are required by the latest specification?” If B’s materials include 30 old specifications and 20 undated documents, the larger desk can still lead to the wrong answer.
Capacity, selection, version conflicts and mistakes in using information are different problems. Identify the problem before choosing a remedy.

blocks.caption: Four Problems and Remedies
rows: Select, summarize or divide the work.
The information is present but misread.

blocks.heading: Check Effective Use as Well as Capacity
paragraphs: Lost in the Middle studied multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval, observing that the position of relevant information could affect performance, especially in the middle of a long context. Those results do not establish the same degree of difficulty for every model and task.

The context window concerns how much can fit at once; retrieval concerns what to fetch now; version management identifies the valid record; and verification checks whether the work was done correctly. Each has a distinct responsibility.

sections.heading: 5. Build Work Records That Can Be Handed Off
paragraphs: Return to the document-intake and missing-item checker. Suppose you are developing it with a coding agent after a long specification discussion. You now need to fix a bug: the system shows “intake complete” even when a required document is missing.
“Keep modifying the intake tool from earlier. You should know the rules” does not identify the valid specification, evidence of the bug or work boundaries. The following handoff makes them explicit.

blocks.caption: Figure 4 | Example Task Handoff
blocks.description: Paths, specifications and test cases are teaching assumptions, not project files established or verified by this lesson.

items.title: Goal
items.body: Fix the incorrect intake-status decision.

items.title: Valid specification
items.body: Use docs/requirements-v3.md: missing required documents must prevent “intake complete.”

items.title: Existing evidence
items.body: Test T-04 shows that the system still reports completion when an attachment is missing.

items.title: Open question
items.body: Whether optional documents affect the status remains unconfirmed.

items.title: Scope
items.body: Change only the status-decision logic and related tests; keep UI colors unchanged.

items.title: Stop condition
items.body: Report a requirement conflict or a need to decide optional-document rules before proceeding.

items.title: Completion condition
items.body: T-04 passes, with the actual test result provided.

blocks.heading: Let the Next Agent Continue the Work
paragraphs: Even if another AI agent takes over tomorrow, it can identify the current goal, governing specification, protected scope and completion criteria. This is a handoff.

Software engineering commonly keeps this information in a Git project’s specifications, tests and version history. Conversation supports discussion; authoritative records make rules and evidence retrievable.

blocks.caption: Figure 5 | From Authoritative Specification to Evidenced Completion
blocks.description: Arrows show the work sequence. Tests and review establish the outcome after execution; formal decisions must update the authoritative record for the next selection.

items.title: Source of truth
items.body: The currently valid rules and version.

items.title: Select relevant material
items.body: Retrieve only the specifications, code and evidence needed now.

items.title: AI agent executes the task
items.body: Use the context currently available.

items.title: Test, review and update records
items.body: Confirm completion with evidence and formally update specifications when necessary.

blocks.heading: What Can a Summary or Response Establish?
paragraphs: A summary is not the authoritative record, and an AI response is not a verification result. If a summary says “all requirements are complete” while tests in Git still fail, the summary does not establish completion. Inspect actual commands, outputs and file versions.

When a specification changes, record the new decision in the authoritative source so the next call does not retrieve stale rules. This workflow must actually be performed and checked; it does not establish that any agent has automatically completed every step.

sections.heading: 6. When Should You Start a New Conversation?
paragraphs: If the goal is unchanged and relevant material is clear, the existing conversation can usually continue. Neither a fresh nor a long conversation guarantees quality; judge whether the working material remains appropriate.
After repeated requirement changes, extensive irrelevant logs or recurring references to an incorrect old specification, prepare a handoff before starting a clean work session.

Reorganize valuable history into correct context for the present task: retain the valid specification, required evidence, open questions and acceptance method. The next lesson compares compaction, RAG and persistent records, including omission, staleness and incorrect retrieval.

sections.heading: 7. Understanding Check: What Actually Went Wrong?
paragraphs: Consider this synthetic teaching scenario: you are developing an internal hospital intake system with an AI agent. Yesterday you confirmed that only administrators may delete intake records; today the agent exposes the delete button to every signed-in user. Use the three checks below to identify the evidence still needed.

The central lesson is to design a workflow that supplies the correct specification and required evidence each time and verifies the result. Asking AI to remember everything forever does not replace these concrete arrangements.

exercise.environment: Paper or Python 3. Use only the assigned token counts; no actual model call is needed.
steps: Classify specifications, history and tool results as authoritative records, currently necessary material or retrievable evidence, explaining your choices.
Check the synthetic budget of 9,500 and remaining 500 using the slider or Python example.
Set extra logs to 1,800 tokens, confirm overflow of 800 and decide which irrelevant material to remove first.
Write a next-call task summary with specification version, sources, unresolved questions and scenarios still needing verification.
exercise.expected: Synthetic budget calculations and a source-traceable task packet, without claiming real service token measurements.
exercise.check: Explain the difference between fitting content and performing the task correctly, and identify information the next call must retrieve again.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic notes and optionally delete the temporary budget program. No external model or account is created.

openChecks.prompt: Question 2: If the specification is already in Git, why might AI still not know this permission rule?
answer: A file’s existence does not establish that it was read in this call. Check the path and version, whether the tool successfully returned the relevant content, whether the assembled context included the administrator-only rule, and whether older rules were mixed in.

openChecks.prompt: Question 3: How would you revise the handoff to reduce the chance of the same error recurring?
answer: Include the valid specification and version, administrator and ordinary-user permission scenarios, current failure evidence, allowed scope, open questions and stop conditions. Completion should require actual permission-test outputs; check server-side rejection of unauthorized deletion as well as button visibility. Record new decisions and results in the authoritative source, with evidence locations in the handoff summary.

zh.prompt: 問題 1：可以直接認定 AI 是因為 Context Window 滿了才犯錯嗎？
options: 可以，一定是舊規則被排除。
不能，還需要檢查上下文與執行證據。
不必檢查，一定是模型不夠聰明。
rationales: 僅看結果無法證明規則未進入上下文。
應分別確認沒看到、看錯版本或看到了卻沒照做，並回查執行結果。
這個判斷跳過了可核對的資料選取、版本與實作證據。

en.prompt: Question 1: Can you immediately conclude that AI made the mistake because the context window was full?
options: Yes; the old rule must have been excluded.
No; context and execution evidence still need inspection.
No inspection is needed; the model must be insufficiently intelligent.
rationales: The outcome alone does not establish that the rule was absent from context.
Distinguish missing information, a wrong version and failure to follow an available rule, then inspect execution results.
This judgment skips inspectable evidence about selection, versions and implementation.
